differences.current_text: PAUL, a legate of Yeshua the Messiah by the pleasure of God, and Timothy a brother,
differences.source_text: PAUL, a legate of Jesus the Messiah by the pleasure of God, and Timothy a brother,

differences.current_text: to them who are at Colosse, the brethren, holy and believing in Yeshua the Messiah: peace be with you, and grace from God our Father.
differences.source_text: to them who are at Colosse, the brethren, holy and believing in Jesus the Messiah: peace be with you, and grace from God our Father.

differences.current_text: We give thanks to God, the Father of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, at all times, and pray for you;
differences.source_text: We give thanks to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus the Messiah, at all times, and pray for you;

differences.current_text: lo, ever since we heard of your faith in Yeshua the Messiah, and of your love to all the saints;
differences.source_text: lo, ever since we heard of your faith in Jesus the Messiah, and of your love to all the saints;

differences.current_text: whom we proclaim, and teach and make known to every man, in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: whom we proclaim, and teach and make known to every man, in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: As therefore ye have received Yeshua the Messiah our Lord, walk ye in him,
differences.source_text: As therefore ye have received Jesus the Messiah our Lord, walk ye in him,

differences.current_text: And whatever ye do in word or act, do it in the name of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, and give thanksgiving through him to God the Father.
differences.source_text: And whatever ye do in word or act, do it in the name of our Lord Jesus the Messiah, and give thanksgiving through him to God the Father.

differences.current_text: also Yeshua, who is called Justus. These are of the circumcision, and they only have aided me in the kingdom of God; and they have been a comfort to me.
